titulo: Cap. 1 — Labirinto 3F: Fuga de Lancer e Resgate de Rin

linhas.en: Is there a checkpoint in that area?

#C236196003Sakura#CDEF is right.
Let's head back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF now.

We obtained the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Let's go back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and rest.

Surely you aren't thinking of WALKING back?
Do you intend to make me march for no purpose?
Look for that #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF!

#C236196003#SVT#CDEF is right.
Let's head back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and get some rest.

Area scan, as well as shield detection,
complete.

Was that not #C236196003Rin#CDEF just now? She appeared
unwell though…

A listless walk.
What happened to that woman?

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF, keep chasing her.
Let's figure out what she's doing.

More… prepare more blood, #C236196003Rin#CDEF…
That's what #C236196003Lancer#CDEF said…
As her Master, I have to obey, properly…

I wonder, why am I doing something so
painful…?
I just became Queen too…

#C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF…!?
H-how long have you been standing there!?

It has been a while now. Ah, but pay no heed
to us. Please, go ahead and continue with your
pleasant self-harm.
"For a slight minute or so," I replied.

After making a shortcut to the old school from
the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF, please return to base.

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF, you appear to have accumulated
a lot of fatigue. I recommend that
you return for the moment to take a rest.

Searching the Labyrinth is nice and all,
but I should #C000246204return to the old school#CDEF to
briefly speak with #C236196003Kiara#CDEF.

I obtained the first #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Let's briefly return to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and sort
out the situation.

First thing to do is activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF.
That'll help move our search along.

We took more damage from our fight with #C236196003Lancer#CDEF
than I expected. Now would be a good time to head
back to the old school.
Luckily, there's a #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF near us.

Don't worry. I'll protect you, Darling.
So, continue on #C000246204ahead#CDEF.

Surely you're not telling me that you're
frightened? Even you understand that stopping
here is impermissible, yes?

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF. After you activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF,
please have yourself a rest in your
private room.
Even in cyberspace, you need proper rest.

Once you activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF,
use it to get back here.
I'll bet you're exhausted, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF.

#[Mr.][Ms.]##C236196003 #NICK#CDEF, return to base for now.
Let's discuss our plan
in the #C000246204Student Council Room#CDEF.

#C236196003Sakura#CDEF's worried state gets across to
me even over the transmission.

She's right, it would be best if
we returned to the #C000246204Old School Building#CDEF.

We obtained the #C000246204SG#CDEF. Let's return to the
#C000246204Old School Building#CDEF for the time being.
We can come again after we recover.

We got the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Mission complete.
Let's head home and get some rest.

Where are you going? We secured the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
There's nothing urgent to tend to.
Back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF, now.

Hrrrm? Where are you going, #C236196003#FAMILY
#GIVEN#CDEF? Where are you going,
leaving me behind?

For a second there, I was thinking about
leaving #C236196003Gatou#CDEF and heading back,
but it probably won't rest easy on my conscience,
so let's turn back.

Wait, Praetor. If we're going to head back,
it'll behoove us for the future to have
the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF activated.

Master, let's look for the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF.
It should be around here somewhere…

We don't need to walk all the way back.
We can use the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF to reach the
old school in a flash. Very nifty.

M-my stomach is at its limit…
I want to hurry back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and get some rest…

Before we go to the next floor,
let's #C000246204head back to the Student Council Room#CDEF.
We need to hand over the data we got from #C236196003Green Archer#CDEF.
He gave his life to entrust us with it.

Huh? You're still in the #C000246204Sakura Labyrinth#CDEF?
Come on, there's nothing to do there.
Get your butt back here!

We'll talk about what comes next tomorrow,
so #C000246204come back and get some rest#CDEF.
After, drop by the Student Council Room.

We're in a race against time.
We need to hurry to the #C000246204Moon Cell's Core#CDEF――!

I can't let #C236196003Shinji#CDEF's hopes go to waste.
Let's press on so we can catch up to #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF!

Praetor, I've grown tired. Let us return
to My Room and have ourselves a bath.

I know how you feel, but knowing
when to rest is also part of the battle.
Let's head back to My Room.

Darling, now is the time for rest.
Let's return to our room and
recover our strength.

What an impatient #[man][woman]#. Laboring away
is not all there is to life, you know?
When it's time to rest, rest.

You may now save your current game data
            as #C000246204Clear Data#CDEF.
linhas.pt:
Agora você pode salvar seus dados
         como #C000246204Clear Data#CDEF.

linhas.en:
You may use this data to carry
over elements to the start of a new game.
linhas.pt:
Você pode usar esses dados para levar
elementos ao início de um novo jogo.

linhas.en:
Please be careful to not overwrite
  the data while you are saving.
linhas.pt:
Tome cuidado para não sobrescrever
  os dados ao salvar.

Are you sure you wish to exit

linhas.en:
Did you see that? That was her just now.
She was looking pale though…
Maybe some food didn't agree with her?

Just now, that zombie-looking thing
crossing over there was #C236196003Rin#CDEF.
We've found some more delightful trouble!

We have also confirmed that was
one of #C236196003Rin#CDEF's other selves.

Her Servant doesn't seem to be around either.
This is your chance to obtain her #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Please pursue her.

Like #C236196003Leo#CDEF said as well: she's clearly acting
strange. Her face is pale, and her eyes look
empty.

In one hand she held a syringe,
which she was sticking into her arm.
What―――on Earth―――

Ahh! But if I defy her,
she'll beat me with that long thing of hers…

That girl always has to have her way, but she's
strong… and a noble… and that tail… When I
hear her orders I feel, like, really―――

It's unclear what she's doing, but it's dangerous.
There's no way I can leave her like that…!

Since just now. Getting hit with something
long―being frustrated, but it feels good―
since around when you mentioned all that.

Since just about a minute ago.
What the hell are you doing…? Looks clearly
like something not good for your body…

I could only make out bits and pieces of what she said,
but could it be that #C236196003Rin#CDEF is being abused by #C236196003Lancer#CDEF…?

J-just leave me alone!
This is a way of making money, that's it!
This has nothing to do with you!

You asked for it! Come on out!
Attack these voyeurs!
Give them a HARSH beating they won't forget!

Ergh, an enemy!
I'll rout it, Master!

Are you some underling in desperation?
What a waste of time…!

Oh. #C236196003Rin#CDEF is so energetic now♪. Okay, okay. Now
my turn… Approach not you useless bureaucrat!
Have you not seen my Darling's family crest!?

Hmph. Has that money system she boasted of
sold out? That spoils the fun.
Drive this thing out, #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF.

Miss #C236196003Tohsaka#CDEF got away, huh?
…looks like this one is quite different
from the others up until now.

There are still signs of this #C236196003Rin#CDEF in the
Labyrinth. Let us try to search the area and
corner her a little more at all costs.

That's not a complexion fit for a beautiful girl.
Praetor, hurry and catch up to her!

Oh dear, Rin is into some bad stuff.
We should stop her quickly, #RUBS  Master#RUBEDarling#REND.

Hahaha, I think you misunderstand, mongrel.
It seems to me like she's enjoying herself.
Rin's signal is just up ahead.

This structure seems different from everything else
so far. Please be extra cautious.

Haa, haa… How many times has it been now,
I wonder…? I've gone back and forth right up
to my threshold…

Ahaha… So cold―so dizzy… but I've got no
choice, yeah. Orders are orders. Orders are
absolute―this is all due to my orders…

I should go collect more, at least…
I have to deliver it soon…

This Miss #C236196003Tohsaka#CDEF IS acting strange after all.
It looks like she hasn't noticed us
intruding yet.

The shadows enveloping the castle have deepened,
I see… Praetor, be on guard. Something
overpowering is here before us.

…looks like this is our last stop. I feel a
remarkably large pressure, but… no, rather
than pressure, could this be… rejection?

Wooow. At last, she shows what she is really
made of. This is a complex structure now, I see.
It is not called a "Labyrinth" for nothing.

Well, now. The atmosphere is different―a
hostile type that is no longer being concealed.
Do not get careless, mongrel.

There are many signs of hostile enemies.
Additionally, two shields have been identified.

How about that singing sound from before…
#C236196003Lancer#CDEF's, it seems?

Signs are stronger than from the second floor.
We can still make contact with #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF,
though…

…there's a high chance that #C236196003Lancer#CDEF is here.
Anticipate a direct confrontation with Miss
#C236196003Tohsaka#CDEF. #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF, be fully prepared.
